policy.semantics: F.Mask and B.Mask graphics are openings, not retained mask
policy.reason: retain only pad solder dams/wicking barriers, narrow solder isolation over surface copper (native solder_mask_bridge prevention), via tents and polarity/assembly silk backing; exact rectangles recorded per board
policy.paste: normal footprint apertures only; no new paste graphics
policy.verification: compare exported positive mask Gerbers to these protected rectangles and pad apertures; fail if any opening, including a pad aperture, comes within via_web_mm of via copper
policy.ink_thickness_status: JLC published minimum, used only as preview/stackup convention; local coating not measured
policy.via_web_reason: Every via keeps at least this much mask between its copper and ANY effective opening, generated rectangle or component pad aperture alike (JLC green 1 oz mask bridge 0.10 mm, same source row). The router keeps via copper this far from every pad aperture (no via in or against a pad); a7_optical_check.py proves it on the native residual mask and a7_gerber_inspect.py on the plotted Gerbers.
